notes.title: Northern Enchantress Release Sale & New Bundle!
notes.notes:
Hello princess supporters! Along with the new bundle we'll have 3 sales! 

The new Expansion and OST will be 25% off for release week, and the base game will be a complimentary 20% off! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/727670/Heart_of_Crown_PC__Northern_Enchantress/

If you'd like to combine these two and buy for them for yourself or a friend and join in the online battles, we're announcing a new permanent bundle where you can purchase both for 15% off together! 

This discount stacks with the sale, so if you've been waiting - now is the time to give Heart of Crown a try!
